data.gender_notes: Nabeelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nabeelah is a name that signifies companionship and loyalty, inspired by the story of Nabeelah bint Qais, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Nabeelah carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabeelah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Nabeelah is a reminder of the importance of companionship and loyalty in our spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Nabeelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabeelah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Nabeelah is a beautiful and evocative name in the Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic word "An-Nabee" which means "The Prophet." Named after Nabeelah bint Qais, this name holds a place of honor in Islamic history as she was one of the ten major companions and followers of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Nabeelah was known for her unyielding devotion and unwavering loyalty to the Prophet, following him despite facing numerous challenges and adversities. Her story is a testament to the enduring bond between the Prophet and his companions.
data.spiritual_significance: Nabeelah, named after the compassionate and loyal companion of the Prophet Muhammad, embodies spiritual qualities that guide us as Muslims. Her steadfast commitment to preserving the teachings of Islam despite facing numerous challenges, reaffirms the importance of patience, resilience, and unwavering faith in Allah (SWT). These qualities serve as valuable reminders for Muslims as they navigate their spiritual journey.
